scope: Qualify the version-gated classic VERTEX identifier field through generated whole-operation ASCII/Binary transaction controls and retain refusal before its implemented AC1024 boundary.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored records generated during each test run
source.profile: 3D POLYLINE with two WCS VERTEX children carrying distinct nonzero group-91 identifiers 101 and 202.

implementation.method: For AC1024/AC1027/AC1032, inject std::bad_alloc at every measured allocation in the complete write, require destination and caller-state preservation, retry with the same codec, compare exact bytes, and require typed readback of both identifiers. For AC1021, require refusal before replacing a seeded destination and unchanged caller state.

limitations: Generated DXF wire and transaction evidence only; producer interoperability and native CAD handling are not qualified.
The version refusal control verifies failure and atomic destination/caller preservation, not a specific CLI diagnostic wording.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: AC1024+ VERTEX group-91 identifiers roundtrip transactionally in ASCII/Binary for AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032; AC1021 refusal preserves state.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the public-writer inventory for other compound-record variants and variable-size OBJECTS builders; retain source-profile and semantic gates.
